name: otp-input
title: OTP Input
description: One-time-code cells that size themselves to fit any width. The active cell glows with a soft focus halo and a blinking caret, digits pop in on a spring, a pasted code fills every cell, errors shake the row and success pulses across the cells with a drawn check.
props: Controlled code (digits only). Pasting a longer string fills every cell.
Called when every cell is filled.
Rounded box cells, underline bars, or round pill cells.
Shakes the row and turns it the danger colour.
Message (with icon) shown under the cells while `error` is set.
Success colour with a staggered pulse across the cells.
Message with an animated check shown while `success` is set.
Hint shown under the cells otherwise.
Draw a dash after this many cells, e.g. 3 → 123 – 456.
Largest cell width; cells shrink to fit the row and never overflow.
Style for the root view around the cells and message.
